name: Eldrazi Conscription
oracle_text:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature gets +10/+10 and has trample and annihilator 2. (Whenever it attacks, defending player sacrifices two permanents of their choice.)
blocked_sentences: Enchanted creature gets +10/+10 and has trample and annihilator 2. (Whenever it attacks, defending player sacrifices two permanents of their choice.)

needs.what: the card type Kindred (formerly Tribal, 308): the type line 'Kindred Enchantment — Eldrazi Aura' lets a noncreature card carry the creature subtype Eldrazi
needs.why_existing_wont_do: the packet's types list (Artifact, Battle, Creature, Enchantment, Instant, Land, Planeswalker, Sorcery) has no Kindred, so the card could only be typed as a plain Enchantment and the Eldrazi subtype would be unexplained to anything reading creature types
